text:
Maya (CS): heads up — Heliotrope going live with pilot tomorrow morning. They're seeing tail latency from eu-west and asked if we can provision a short-lived allowlist + temporary rate bump for their demo traffic.
Priya (AM): renewal flagged as at-risk if latency issues persist. If we can stabilize their demo it helps the renewal convo next week.
Diego (NetOps): ok. I can add CIDR to the egress allowlist and open a qos override for their routing pool. need the CIDR and how long.
Maya (CS): customer provided two CIDRs and wants ap-south added as well: `18.45.32.0/24` and `103.21.110.0/26`. Requesting a short *burst* increase: 150 requests/min for 3 hours, then back to normal.
Cam (Infra): @Diego I can push the policy but we should gate it with an autodelete after expiry. also prefer setting a soft quota instead of permanent rate change.
Diego (NetOps): agreed. Suggested config (I'll apply):
```json
{\n  "customer": "heliotrope",\n  "allowlist": ["18.45.32.0/24", "103.21.110.0/26"],\n  "regions": ["eu-west-1", "ap-south-1"],\n  "rate_policy": {"type": "temporary_burst", "requests_per_min": "150", "duration_minutes": "180"},\n  "auto_revoke": "true",\n  "revoke_after": "180m"\n}
```
Maya (CS): perfect. Can you add a note to the account that this is a demo-only tweak and that we'll revoke automatically? Also, notify the customer 1 hour before revoke.
Cam (Infra): change ticket created CHG-4521. tagging @Diego for apply.
InfraBot: change CHG-4521 scheduled, window starts in 6m, runbook attached.
Diego (NetOps): applied allowlist + rate override to the eu-west routing pool and ap-south proxy. verified with sample requests — 95th latency dropped ~30%.
Priya (AM): awesome, I'll update the renewal playbook and tell them we'll monitor for 24h. Also adding a follow-up enablement session to capture feedback.
Maya (CS): I'll shoot an email to Heliotrope: confirm patch applied, will auto-revoke in 3h, and offer a short post-demo call.
Priya (AM): noted renewal risk decreased — moving from "watch" -> "on track" unless we see regressions.
Cam (Infra): post-change note: set auto-revoke cron `@run +180m` on CHG-4521; leaving audit log.
Maya (CS): thanks team :party_parrot: — closing the thread once the revoke runs.
Diego (NetOps): on it, will post when revoke completes.
InfraBot: CHG-4521 auto-revoke completed at +183m, revocation successful.
Diego (NetOps): revoke confirmed, all policies returned to baseline.
Maya (CS): closing. Customer follow-up scheduled; capture feedback from demo for product/infra improvements. :white_check_mark:
